cues.zh: 我們著重評估模型表現。

cues.zh: 指定為 losses，執行。

cues.en: And let's go ahead and plot these out.
cues.zh: 再把它們畫出來。

cues.en: So we'll say losses plot.
cues.zh: 呼叫 losses.plot。

cues.zh: 現在查看 losses，有 loss 和 val_loss。

cues.en: This validation loss is the loss on our test set that X test and Y test.

cues.zh: 希望執行後能看到類似行為；看起來訓練損失和驗證損失都在下降，但最後驗證集上，

cues.en: that much on the validation.

cues.zh: 值得探索的事情，是加入 EarlyStopping 回呼，訓練更多 epoch，看看損失是否繼續下降，

cues.en: or if it would've started increasing.
cues.zh: 或開始上升。

cues.en: Let's go ahead and continue to the next task which was create predictions from the X test set and display a classification report and confusion matrix for that test set.
cues.zh: 下一個任務是對 X_test 建立預測，顯示測試集的分類報告與混淆矩陣。

cues.en: The way we can do that is from SK learn dot metrics we'll go ahead and import a classification report and a confusion matrix.
cues.zh: 從 sklearn.metrics 匯入 classification_report 和 confusion_matrix。

cues.en: We can grab our predictions by simply grabbing our model and running predict classes.
cues.zh: 對模型呼叫 predict_classes，就能取得預測。

cues.en: And then you just need to pass in some features like X test and that returns back predictions.
cues.zh: 傳入 X_test 之類的特徵，便會傳回預測值。

cues.en: In which case, once that's done we can print out a classification report that takes in, if you take a look at it, whoops, not prints,
cues.zh: 完成後就能印出分類報告；看一下，哎呀，不是 print，

cues.en: but the actual classification report that takes in Y true versus Y predictions.
cues.zh: 而是 classification_report 本身，會接收 y_true 和預測值。

cues.en: So we'll pass in Y true versus our predictions.
cues.zh: 所以傳入 y_true 與 predictions。

cues.en: And because this is a classification task recall we're going to have different, whoops this should be why test.
cues.zh: 因為這是分類任務，還記得有不同……哎呀，這裡應該是 y_test。

cues.en: And as I was saying, because it's a classification task there's going to be different metrics we can evaluate this by.
cues.zh: 如剛才所說，分類任務可以用不同指標評估。

cues.en: There's going to be an accuracy metric a precision metric, recall, an F one score.
cues.zh: 包括準確率、精確率、召回率和 F1 分數。

cues.en: So accuracy that's just the actual percent that we got right.
cues.zh: 準確率就是實際預測正確的百分比。

cues.en: So if you did the same random split we did the exact same network we're looking at around 90% accuracy.
cues.zh: 如果使用相同的隨機切分和網路，準確率大約是 90%。

cues.en: But recall that in the very beginning of this notebook so all the way at the top, what we did is we first analyzed the actual label itself
cues.zh: 但還記得，這份筆記本最前面，先分析了實際標籤，

cues.en: and recall that it's an imbalanced labels.
cues.zh: 而標籤是不平衡的。

cues.en: There's a lot more fully paid than there are charged off loans.
cues.zh: 全額清償的貸款遠多於呆帳貸款。

cues.en: And in fact, if we were to take a look at a model that simply recalled back any loan as being fully paid it would actually still be pretty accurate.
cues.zh: 實際上，如果模型只把所有貸款都預測為全額清償，準確率仍會滿高。

cues.en: So we'll scroll down here and just to kind of show you what I mean by that if we take a look at our original data frame
cues.zh: 往下看，為了說明，查看原始資料框，

cues.en: and we have whether or not our loan was repaid what we're going to do is let's do some value counts here
cues.zh: 其中有貸款是否清償的資訊，對它做 value_counts，

cues.en: and we have this many loan repaid.
cues.zh: 得到這些還款人數。

cues.en: So let's go ahead and take that and divide it by the actual length of that data frame and run that.
cues.zh: 再除以資料框實際長度，執行。

cues.en: So notice here that what this is indicating is that 80% of my points were already being predicted as loan repaid, which means if I created
cues.zh: 注意，這表示 80% 的資料點本來就是已清償，意思是如果建立，

cues.en: a very simple model that simply said any loan will be repaid, I would be 80% accurate.
cues.zh: 一個非常簡單、總是說所有貸款都會還清的模型，準確率就是 80%。

cues.en: So don't be fooled by a model that returns back 80% accuracy because by default a model that just always reports back the loan will be repaid itself will be 80% accurate
cues.zh: 所以別被傳回 80% 準確率的模型騙了，因為只要一律預測貸款會清償，準確率就有 80%，

cues.en: more or less on this actual test dataset.
cues.zh: 在這份測試集上大致如此。

cues.en: So we should be looking at kind of a bottom threshold of 80%, which means our 89% accuracy here is okay, but it's not absolutely fantastic because of our imbalance data set.
cues.zh: 所以應該把 80% 視為基本門檻；這裡 89% 的準確率算可以，但因為資料不平衡，並沒有特別出色。

cues.en: As mentioned in the machine learning metric lectures the actual metrics we wanna take a look at are precision, recall, and F one score.
cues.zh: 正如機器學習評估指標課所說，真正該看的是精確率、召回率和 F1 分數。

cues.en: And it looks like depending on the class we perform a little worse.
cues.zh: 看起來某些類別的表現比較差。

cues.en: So the true class we should be looking at here is the one that's lower representation, which is zero.
cues.zh: 真正該留意的是占比較低的類別，也就是零。

cues.en: So no, we have a lot less instances of zero.
cues.zh: 注意，零的案例少得多。

cues.en: We're pretty good on the precision here, but really where we suffer is the recall and we can get an F one score which recalls the harmonic mean between precision and recall.
cues.zh: 精確率不錯，但召回率表現較差；還能看 F1 分數，還記得，它是精確率與召回率的調和平均數。

cues.en: So really the true notification of whether or not this model is doing well, is this F one score on this zero class.
cues.zh: 所以真正判斷模型好壞的，是零這個類別的 F1 分數。

cues.en: So what I would encourage you to do is see if you can play around with the model hyper parameters maybe add in more layers, add in more neurons maybe play around with the dropout rate
cues.zh: 我建議嘗試調整模型超參數，也許加更多層、更多神經元，或改變 Dropout 比率，

cues.en: to see if you can improve off a base 0.61 F one score.
cues.zh: 看能不能超越 0.61 的基準 F1 分數。

cues.en: Okay, so is this good or bad?
cues.zh: 好，這到底算好還是不好？

cues.en: Well, that really depends on the entire context of the situation whether we have a model that already attempts to predict this and what's its F one score.
cues.zh: 取決於整體情境，是否已有其他模型在預測，以及它的 F1 分數是多少。

cues.en: So we need a lot more context to decide whether or not this recall and the F one score are good enough.
cues.zh: 所以需要更多背景，才能判斷這樣的召回率和 F1 分數是否夠好。

cues.en: What we can say right off the bat is that this accuracy is better than just kind of a default guess, which would be 80%.
cues.zh: 立刻能確認的是，這個準確率比預設猜測的 80% 更好。

cues.en: So this model is definitely better than just kind of a random guess or a straight guess.
cues.zh: 所以模型確實比隨機猜測，或固定猜一個答案更好。

cues.en: So we are performing much better.
cues.zh: 我們表現更好。

cues.en: A random guess would get 50% accuracy.
cues.zh: 隨機猜測會得到 50% 準確率。

cues.en: A straight guess of always being repaid would get 80% accuracy.
cues.zh: 固定猜一定清償，會得到 80% 準確率。

cues.en: And our model is getting 89% accuracy.
cues.zh: 我們的模型則有 89%。

cues.en: So we are performing better than both a random guess and a straight loan repaid return.
cues.zh: 所以比隨機猜測和固定傳回已清償都更好。

cues.en: Okay? So overall we can see that our model is learning something from this dataset and then we can see the confusion matrix as well.
cues.zh: 好，整體而言，模型確實從資料學到東西，也能查看混淆矩陣。

cues.en: If we're interested in that we can perform Y test versus predictions.
cues.zh: 若感興趣，傳入 y_test 和 predictions。

cues.en: Run that.
cues.zh: 執行。

cues.en: And we get to see this confusion matrix.
cues.zh: 就能看到這個混淆矩陣。

cues.en: And again, you can see we're misclassifying a lot of those zero points which causes this kind of low recall.
cues.zh: 同樣可以看到，許多零被分類錯誤，導致召回率偏低。

cues.en: Okay, so given the last task of giving the customer below would you offer this person a loan?
cues.zh: 最後一個任務，根據下方客戶，你會提供貸款嗎？

cues.en: What we're going to do here is basically use our model to run on a single person.
cues.zh: 基本上就是對單一客戶執行模型。

cues.en: So we'll simply import random seed, set it to 1 0 1 and then we'll create a random index using this.
cues.zh: 匯入 random，設定 seed 為 101，再用這個方式產生隨機索引。

cues.en: Then off this random index we're going to grab some new customer
cues.zh: 根據這個隨機索引，取得新客戶，

cues.en: and then display their actual features.
cues.zh: 顯示他的實際特徵。

cues.en: So go ahead and run this and if you ran everything the same you should get the same random customer that we got.
cues.zh: 執行，如果所有操作都相同，應該就會得到和我一樣的隨機客戶。

cues.en: And you can play around off the seed if you want a different random customer.
cues.zh: 想換不同客戶，也可以調整 seed。

cues.en: And the way we would actually predict off this customer is first we have to make sure that this is no longer a panda series, but actually a NumPy array.
cues.zh: 要對這位客戶預測，首先必須確認資料不再是 pandas Series，而是 NumPy 陣列。

cues.en: So this is kind of the hardest part is making sure your data's in the right shape.
cues.zh: 最難的部分，就是確認資料形狀正確。

cues.en: So a new customer right now, it's a panda series.
cues.zh: 現在 new_customer 是 pandas Series。

cues.en: What I need to do is grab the values which returns back these feature values, and then after that I need to reshape this to be in the same shape
cues.zh: 必須取得 values，得到這些特徵值，再重塑形狀，使其符合，

cues.en: of the training data that the model was trained on which in our case is one by 78.
cues.zh: 模型訓練時使用的資料形狀，這裡是一乘 78。

cues.en: And that essentially adds a little extra bracket call there which is what our model expects.
cues.zh: 基本上就是多加一層中括號，符合模型預期。

cues.en: And then we're going to go ahead and make sure that we scale this data in order to predict the correct class because recall our model learned on scaled data.
cues.zh: 接著確保資料經過縮放，才能預測正確類別，因為模型是用縮放後的資料學習。

cues.en: So we'll take our scaler and we will transform this data and set that to our new customer.
cues.zh: 所以用 scaler 轉換這份資料，再指定為 new_customer。

cues.en: So say a new customer, run that, let's go ahead and check out our new customer.
cues.zh: 設為 new_customer，執行，查看結果。

cues.en: So now we have a scaled version of this new customer and let's pass this into the model.
cues.zh: 現在有了新客戶的縮放資料，傳入模型。

cues.en: Say model, predict classes on this new customer run that and our model predicts that it was a one.
cues.zh: 用 model.predict_classes 預測 new_customer，執行後模型預測為一。

cues.en: So now let's actually check did this person actually end up paying back their loan?
cues.zh: 現在檢查，這個人最後真的有還款嗎？

cues.en: So what we're going to do here is essentially run this same command here, but we won't actually drop it.
cues.zh: 基本上執行相同指令，但不再刪掉標籤。

cues.en: We just want that actual column there, run it.
cues.zh: 只要那個實際欄，執行。

cues.en: And if we look at the very bottom or we can just call it ourselves, we want to see whether or not the loan was repaid and it happened to be repaid.
cues.zh: 看最下面，或直接選取，查看 loan_repaid，結果確實清償了。

cues.en: So it looks like in this particular case, we got it right.
cues.zh: 所以這個例子，我們預測正確。

cues.en: Alright, so that's it for this project.
cues.zh: 好，專案就到這裡。

cues.en: Notice it was a very large project, but a big part of it was actually feature engineering and understanding the data.
cues.zh: 注意，這是很大的專案，但很大一部分其實是特徵工程和理解資料。

cues.en: Usually when it comes to actually training the model itself that's a much simpler task because the model is doing most of the work.
cues.zh: 真正訓練模型通常反而簡單許多，因為大部分工作由模型完成。

cues.en: All you need to decide on is how many layers and how many neurons per layer.
cues.zh: 只需要決定層數，以及每層的神經元數量。

cues.en: So there's lots of options to play around with here and I would encourage you to play around with your own models and see if you can beat our performance that we've shown here with this simpler model.
cues.zh: 有許多選項能嘗試，我建議用自己的模型實驗，看看能否超越這個簡單模型的表現。

cues.en: Thanks, and I'll see you at the next lecture.
cues.zh: 謝謝，下堂課見。
